title: LangChain serialization injection can extract environment secrets
summary: Unescaped lc dictionaries pass through dumps/dumpd and become LangChain objects during load/loads. With the former secrets_from_env=True default, injected structures can extract environment secrets, including through model-controlled response fields.

severity.rationale: Secret extraction through untrusted agent data warrants a 72-hour response. Exposure requires the affected serialization and deserialization path, rather than every use of LangChain.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.

exposure: Untrusted dictionaries must pass through the affected APIs. The vendor also identifies astream_events(version="v1") and astream_log; astream_events(version="v2") is unaffected.

remediation.details: Install 0.3.81 or later on the 0.3 line, or 1.2.5 or later on the 1.x line. Retain restrictive deserialization defaults.
remediation.risk: New object allowlists, disabled environment-secret loading and Jinja2 blocking can break existing deserialization.

verification: Check the installed branch and patched version, then test required serialization with the new defaults.
